description: Create a new invoice for a client, with line items, optional discount, due date, contacts, and invoice-level taxes.

client_id.description: Client ULID (must belong to the active company)

contact_ids.description: Client contact ULIDs to attach to the invoice (optional)

discount_value.description: Numeric discount value; required if discount_type is set

invoice_taxes.description:
Invoice-level taxes (withholding/surcharge/informational):
[{tax_id, direction: Additive|Deductive|Informational, sequence?, note?}].
Deductive (TDS) reduces payable; Additive grows total; Informational records amount=0.

lines.description:
Line items: [{name, description?, price, qty, tax_id?, taxes?: [{tax_id, sequence?, compound?}]}, ...].
Price is in the minor unit (e.g. cents). Provide `taxes[]` for multi-tax lines
(India GST split, Quebec GST+QST compound); `tax_id` is the legacy single-tax shorthand.

payment_terms.description:
due_on_receipt, net_7, net_14, net_15, net_30, net_45, net_60, net_90, end_of_month,
end_of_next_month or custom. Any value but custom sets the due date from the invoice date.
Defaults to the client's terms (else the company's), or custom when `due` is given.
`due` can only be combined with custom.

name: create_invoice
